note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a QAT 2(1); A06b QAT 2(1), Decision 14/2007; L05 QAT 11(5)): ordinary naturalisation after 25 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships; a citizen loses the citizenship on voluntarily taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Qatar, 2024
sources.said: Person has been resident in the country for at least 25 years. ... Applicant for naturalisation must submit proof that he/she has relinquished original citizenship. ... Person acquires citizenship of another country.
